hostiles.attack: Candidate basis is just a universal computer/interpreter with mutable memory.
hostiles.required_test: Demand a nontrivial bounded learnability/resource/phase prediction not implied by simulation.

hostiles.attack: Primitive vocabulary contains a hidden neural layer, production rule, Bayes update, interpreter, or program synthesizer that bakes in the target morphology.
hostiles.required_test: Prior-information audit plus primitive ablation/expansion into lower-level operations.

hostiles.attack: Search encoding makes one morphology dramatically easier to express, so apparent emergence is a representation artifact.
hostiles.required_test: At least two materially different encodings/compilers with matched phenotype class and a reminted search representation.

hostiles.attack: Morphology labels are defined after seeing winners.
hostiles.required_test: Freeze morphology equivalence/classifier procedure before protected search; preserve NON_IDENTIFIABLE outcomes.

hostiles.attack: Two architectures are called different despite equivalent behavior and developmental response under bounded compilation.
hostiles.required_test: Developmental equivalence quotient, not syntax/graph distance alone.

hostiles.attack: Compiler preserves current I/O but not learning/update dynamics.
hostiles.required_test: Paired developmental sequences and update-cost checks.

hostiles.attack: One morphology appears efficient because training, search, index construction, verification, compilation or maintenance is omitted.
hostiles.required_test: Full resource vector from basis construction through developmental use and revision.

hostiles.attack: A morphology wins only under a resource scalarization chosen after outcomes.
hostiles.required_test: Report raw resource vectors/Pareto frontier and preregister any scalar price vector.

hostiles.attack: Ecology coordinates are invented after observing which morphology won.
hostiles.required_test: Freeze coordinates and quantitative/directional prediction before protected outcomes; unexpected result becomes a new study.

hostiles.attack: Track B calls a phenomenon new while AutoML-Zero, NEAT, MAML, probabilistic programming, program synthesis, categorical learning, AIXI/OOPS/PowerPlay or another mature parent already explains it.
hostiles.required_test: Parent-function ledger with strongest faithful reconstruction and explicit residual.

hostiles.attack: Observed phase law is actually a property of the chosen search algorithm rather than the morphology/economics.
hostiles.required_test: Random/enumerative parent where tractable plus at least two search families on the same frozen basis/ecology.

hostiles.attack: Neural morphology gets optimized continuous parameters while symbolic/programmatic parents get weak hand settings, or vice versa.
hostiles.required_test: Matched adaptation/search rights and budget; strongest domain-native optimizer for each morphology.

hostiles.attack: Probabilistic basis claims generality only because deterministic systems are treated as delta distributions without explaining their structural/resource differences.
hostiles.required_test: Bounded compilation and phase behavior must distinguish when stochastic state/inference is actually useful.

hostiles.attack: A program basis 'derives' a neural network only by invoking an opaque matrix/gradient primitive equivalent to the entire neural computation.
hostiles.required_test: Expand primitive to registered lower-level operations and charge compilation/update overhead.

hostiles.attack: Local-transducer or learner basis 'derives' programmatic intelligence by adding an arbitrary universal interpreter primitive.
hostiles.required_test: Interpreter must itself compile from the basis at bounded registered cost or remain an explicit parent donor.

hostiles.attack: Ecology/morphology selector reads task family IDs or other labels that directly reveal the preferred architecture.
hostiles.required_test: Remint labels/surfaces and use only preregistered measurable ecology properties.

hostiles.attack: Phase transition appears on one designed ecology family only.
hostiles.required_test: Disjoint generator/fresh host/independent task family and ideally second implementation for the phase classifier.

hostiles.attack: Fundamental basis includes warrant/provenance/authority because current OCM uses them, making OCM win by construction.
hostiles.required_test: Keep those properties morphology/ecology-level unless minimality evidence demonstrates basis-level necessity.
